Outreach

Teaching & outreach

From managing a 5,500-strong amateur astronomy community at IIT Bombay to leading hands-on FRB workshops for early-career researchers, I care about making this science legible outside the room it was done in.

2025

Caltech Astronomy Outreach Volunteer

Caltech

Q&A panelist for a public star-gazing lecture.

Engaged with the community and communicated astronomy research in an accessible way, contributing to public science outreach through interactive discussions and Q&A on radio astronomy, the DSA-2000 survey, and the science of the night sky.

AUDIENCE — General public
2025

Lecturer, FTSky Workshop

International Center for Theoretical Sciences (ICTS), TIFR

A program in the field of Fast Radio Transients — an intensive, hands-on training workshop.

Led an intensive hands-on training session on optical studies of FRB host galaxies, covering archival data mining, data reduction, galaxy morphology, and SED analysis. Designed and delivered lectures and tutorials on probabilistic host-galaxy association, optical spectroscopy, and SED modeling, guiding participants through real astronomical analysis workflows.

AUDIENCE — 100+ students
2021 – 2024

Teaching Assistant, Graduate-Level Courses

Caltech and IIT Bombay

Ay124: Structure and Evolution of Galaxies (Prof. Phil Hopkins, Caltech, Winter 2024); Ay121: Radiative Processes (Prof. Sterl Phinney, Caltech, Fall 2023); PH556: Astrophysics (Prof. Varun Bhalerao, IIT Bombay, Spring 2021).

Conducted tutorials, graded assignments, mentored students, and supported smooth course delivery.

AUDIENCE — Graduate students
2024

Maunakea Astroday Public Outreach Program Volunteer

Astronomer Community Engagement (ACE) Program, Caltech Optical Observatories

A public outreach event introducing multi-wavelength astronomy to schoolchildren.

Introduced elementary school students to the fundamentals of UV, IR, and optical astronomy, and demonstrated how infrared observations probe the dust-obscured content of star-forming galaxies.

AUDIENCE — Elementary school students
Summer 2020

Lecturer, Scientific Computation & Mathematical Modeling Course

IIT Bombay

A hands-on Python and numerical-methods course.

Provided hands-on Python training to students on solving scientific problems, and designed course material on numerical methods and algorithms for differential equations.

AUDIENCE — 250+ students
2020 – 2021

Project Moderator, Summer of Science

IIT Bombay

A three-month-long guided reading project program.

Advised a group of students through a three-month-long reading project, fostering active discussions by sharing resources on observational astronomy.

AUDIENCE — 6 students
2019 – 2021

Amateur Astronomy Club Manager, Krittika

The Astronomy Club of IIT Bombay

Institute-wide astronomy programming, projects, and night-sky observation sessions.

Managed 10 conveners tending to the club's community. Supervised 6 projects, 2 week-long tutorials on numerical computing, and 3-day workshops. Ideated Team ANYmations to generate scriptable scientific animations for publicity campaigns. Organized institute-wide lectures, discussions, documentary screenings, and competitions such as Astromania and the Scientific Computation/Observation Planning Championships. Conducted night-sky observation sessions and familiarized beginners with telescope handling and observation planning.

AUDIENCE — ~100 members at IITB, ~5,500 online enthusiasts
